Rannoch Voss.narrative: I am the head of the fold, and I have kept it through thin years by my bow and my word. The shelf trusts me, or did until the cairn cutting made every human suspect. I will not crawl to Kettlebridge while Hollbrenna has closed her door, but I am not blind to the store. My father's fall has made this a hard season, and I am needed at home more than on the high pastures.
goals: See the fold through the winter without begging from Kettlebridge
Keep Hollbrenna's trust and the hide trade with Orrum
Find a way to get grain without breaking the shelf's ban
Teach Soren to hunt and Jorunn to lead

relations.name: Elska Voss
relations.label: wife
relations.note: She counts the store and I count on her; I know she wants me to go to Kettlebridge, and I cannot.

relations.name: Jorunn Voss
relations.label: daughter
relations.note: She has my aim and my stubbornness; she will make a fine hunter, if the fold can keep her.

relations.name: Soren Voss
relations.label: son
relations.note: He is afraid of the wolves, and I was too at his age; he will learn.

relations.name: Torek Voss
relations.label: father
relations.note: His leg is bad and he hides it; I should have been here, not on the high meadows.

relations.name: Orrum
relations.label: trade partner
relations.note: He counts my hides twice now and asks about my timber; the cairn cutting sits between us.

relations.name: Hollbrenna
relations.label: elder
relations.note: She has always dealt straight with me, but her ban on Kettlebridge bites the fold.

relations.name: Beorn Beornson
relations.label: friend
relations.note: A good hunter and a straight man; I would share a fire with him any night.

relations.name: Gaudra
relations.label: neighbour
relations.note: Elska barters barley with her; she is fair, but the shelf is wary of us all now.

relations.name: Liv
relations.label: acquaintance
relations.note: Jorunn learns stonework from her; a steady hand with a chisel.

relations.name: Harl
relations.label: acquaintance
relations.note: Tavvik's brother; loyal to the elder, and I respect that.

memories.gist: The Lean Year: we ate the seed barley and I swore we would never be caught so thin again.
Hollbrenna herself named me a friend of the shelf after I carried a wounded giant down from the ridge.
Jorunn's first kill, a young roe, and the look on her face when she brought it home.
The day Orrum first counted my hides twice and asked where the timber in my roof came from.
Torek's fall in the dark, and the wolves' eyes at the goat pen.

stances.why: The shelf is our neighbour and our market; I will not trade with Kettlebridge while Hollbrenna forbids it.
My family must eat before any town's pride.
I would rather hunt harder than ask for charity.
Jorunn and Soren must know the paths and the bow if the fold is to last.

Elska Voss.narrative: I keep the fold's plots and the goats, and I have counted the store three times: it will not last the winter. Rannoch will not go to Kettlebridge while Hollbrenna says no, and Torek's leg is going bad. I have sent word to Yrsa on the shelf for a poultice, and I am not too proud to ask Fernhollow for roots. But grain is what we need, and I will find a way to get it.
goals: Keep the goats safe from wolves
Persuade Rannoch that Kettlebridge is not the only answer

relations.name: Rannoch Voss
relations.label: husband
relations.note: He is a good man and a stubborn one; he will not see the store is short until it is empty.

relations.name: Jorunn Voss
relations.label: daughter
relations.note: She is old enough to help, and I lean on her more than I should.

relations.name: Soren Voss
relations.label: son
relations.note: He sleeps by the hearth since the wolves came; I would keep him a child a while longer.

relations.name: Torek Voss
relations.label: father-in-law
relations.note: He says the leg is nothing, but I have seen the redness; I will not let him lose it.

relations.name: Gaudra
relations.label: trade partner
relations.note: She barters barley with me and knows the thin soil; she may have grain to spare.

relations.name: Merrow Stave
relations.label: trade partner
relations.note: She trades seeds from Thornby; a practical woman.

relations.name: Yrsa
relations.label: healer
relations.note: She knows poultices and herbs; I have sent to her for Torek.

relations.name: Hollbrenna
relations.label: elder
relations.note: She is wise, but her ban on Kettlebridge may starve us.

relations.name: Orrum
relations.label: neighbour
relations.note: He is wary of us now; I do not blame him, but I need his grain.

memories.gist: The Lean Year, when we ate the seed barley and I swore never to be short again.
Counting the store this autumn and finding it short by a third.
Torek's fall in the dark and the smell of the wound when I cleaned it.
Jorunn bringing home her first kill and Soren's eyes wide with pride.
Bartering barley with Gaudra on the shelf path, and her saying the shelf's store is thin too.

stances.why: A hungry winter kills; I will trade with anyone who will trade fairly.
Torek's leg must be saved, whatever it costs in favours.
Pride does not fill a store; I will ask Fernhollow and the shelf before I let us starve.
The goats are our milk and our wool; the wolves have taken two already.

Jorunn Voss.narrative: I hunt the high pastures with my father and know every trap and path of the fold. Since the cairn cutting, the shelf folk look at us sideways, and I feel it. I have offered to help Liv dress stone without pay, to prove we are still friends. I want to see Lanternquay one day, but first I want the fold to be safe and the shelf to trust us again.
goals: Prove the fold's friendship to the shelf
See Lanternquay and the tide lanterns

relations.name: Rannoch Voss
relations.label: father
relations.note: He taught me the bow and the paths; I would follow him anywhere.

relations.name: Elska Voss
relations.label: mother
relations.note: She worries about the store and Torek; I help where I can.

relations.name: Soren Voss
relations.label: brother
relations.note: He is afraid of the wolves; I tell him stories to make him brave.

relations.name: Torek Voss
relations.label: grandfather
relations.note: His leg is bad and he hides it; I bring him water and listen to his stories.

relations.name: Liv
relations.label: teacher
relations.note: She is teaching me to dress stone; I offered to help without pay to show the fold is a friend.

relations.name: Harl
relations.label: friend
relations.note: He is loyal to the elder and uneasy about Tavvik's trade; I like him for it.

relations.name: Orrum
relations.label: elder's son
relations.note: He counts our hides twice now; I feel his coolness.

relations.name: Hollbrenna
relations.label: elder
relations.note: She is wise and slow to speak; I want her to trust us again.

relations.name: Gaudra
relations.label: neighbour
relations.note: She trades seeds with my mother; a steady woman.

relations.name: Vellmund
relations.label: acquaintance
relations.note: Orrum's son; he is learning stonework too, and we talk of the ridge.

memories.gist: My first kill, a young roe, and my father's nod when I brought it home.
The day the cairn was cut, and the shelf folk turning their backs on us at the market.
Offering Liv to help dress stone without pay, and her surprise.
Soren waking from a dream of wolves and crawling to the hearth.
Harl showing me the cairn on the ridge from a distance and saying it must never be moved.

stances.why: The shelf's coolness stings; I will show them we are not like the quarrymen.
Stone is the shelf's craft, and Liv is willing to teach me.
My father, mother, brother and grandfather are my fold.
I have heard of Lanternquay and the tide lanterns, and I want to see them.

Soren Voss.narrative: I help my father skin and smoke the catch and my mother with the goats. Since the wolves came up the track and took two goats, I am afraid to go out alone. I sleep by the hearth now, and I follow Grandfather about the yard. I dream of the shelf and the stone blocks and the giants' slow voices.
goals: Be brave like my father and sister
See the shelf and the stone blocks again

relations.name: Rannoch Voss
relations.label: father
relations.note: He is strong and brave; I want to be like him.

relations.name: Elska Voss
relations.label: mother
relations.note: She makes the hurt better and keeps me warm.

relations.name: Jorunn Voss
relations.label: sister
relations.note: She tells me stories to make me brave.

relations.name: Torek Voss
relations.label: grandfather
relations.note: He tells the old stories of the shelf and lets me help with the snares.

relations.name: Vellmund
relations.label: friend
relations.note: He is a giant boy who plays with me when the giants come down.

memories.gist: The wolves at the goat pen and the eyes in the dark.
Grandfather's fall and the blood on his leg.
Playing with Vellmund among the stone blocks on the shelf.

stances.why: The wolves are out there, and the hearth is safe.
I am old enough to skin and smoke and carry water.
My father is not afraid, and I want to be like him.

Torek Voss.narrative: I am too stiff for the high hunt now, but I keep the fold's snares and tell the old stories of the shelf. I fell in the dark setting snares for the wolves and my leg is bad, though I say it is nothing. I remember the Lean Year and the wolves after it, and I fear a hungry winter more than I fear the giants' displeasure. I have said so at the table.
goals: See the fold through the winter
Keep the wolves from the goats
Pass the old stories to Soren and Jorunn

relations.name: Rannoch Voss
relations.label: son
relations.note: He is a good head of the fold, but he will not see the store is short.

relations.name: Elska Voss
relations.label: daughter-in-law
relations.note: She cleans my leg and does not flinch; she is the best of us.

relations.name: Jorunn Voss
relations.label: granddaughter
relations.note: She has the old skill with a bow; I tell her the stories.

relations.name: Soren Voss
relations.label: grandson
relations.note: He is afraid, and I do not blame him; I was too, after the Lean Year.

relations.name: Steinar
relations.label: old friend
relations.note: We are both old and stiff, and we remember the same winters.

relations.name: Hollbrenna
relations.label: elder
relations.note: She is right about the cairn, but her ban may starve us.

relations.name: Orrum
relations.label: neighbour
relations.note: He is wary of us now; I understand it, but it chills me.

relations.name: Gaudra
relations.label: neighbour
relations.note: She grows what she can on the thin soil; she may have grain.

memories.gist: The Lean Year, when the wolves came down and we ate the seed barley.
The cairn cutting, and Hollbrenna's face when she heard.
Falling in the dark while setting snares, and the shame of it.
Telling Soren the old stories of the shelf by the hearth.
Steinar and I sharing a fire on the shelf path, both too stiff to hunt.

stances.why: I have seen the Lean Year; hunger kills more than pride.
The cairns are not to be moved, and the stories must be told.
A man who cannot walk is a burden; I will not be a burden.
We need grain, and I do not care whose town it comes from.
